title: a trace file's name is legal on every box and every reader finds it
intention: learning_block names a block's trace file without ':' (legal on NTFS), reads both that name and the legacy 'skill:<name>.jsonl' name, and every reader in the repo goes through it.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell (Windows): every skill firing (/idea, /intent, /sorted) fails WinError 87 because write_trace renames to 'skill:<name>.jsonl'; NTFS reads the colon as an alternate data stream and leaves an empty file 'skill' behind. No skill door can run on Windows, so nothing can be born there.
traces_to: Law 3 and Law 5 - a corpus the watches measure must be writable and readable on every box; Law 1 - one function names a trace file, not seven hand-built spellings.
how: Add public trace_path(block, root=None) -> Path (':'->'__') and legacy_trace_path to learning_block; write_trace folds any legacy file into the new one then unlinks it; read_trace reads legacy then new; clearance and the three skill probes move onto read_trace/trace_path. Red-first proof: a hollow writer fails it.

clauses.claim: write_trace for a block named 'skill:x' writes a file whose name contains no Windows-reserved character and the record is read back by read_trace
read_trace over a store holding a legacy 'skill:x.jsonl' plus a new file returns the records of both, legacy first
a write onto a store holding a legacy file folds its records into the new file, retires the legacy file and loses no record
the intent, sorted and saveslate door-refusal probes and clearance count the same passes and refusals over a legacy-only store and over a new-name-only store
no source file outside learning_block builds a '<block>.jsonl' trace path by hand

decisions.text: D1: learning_block gains public trace_path/legacy_trace_path; write_trace folds-and-retires the legacy file; read_trace reads both.
D2: clearance and the three skill door-refusal probes read through read_trace instead of hand-built names.
D3: one proof, one tooth per clause, in a scratch trace root; clause 5 is a git-grep over the repo.

out: engine_trace_corpus probe (globs the store, unaffected by the name)

measured.saw: WinError 87 renaming skill:idea.tmp to skill:idea.jsonl; an empty file 'skill' left in ~/.cairn/devices/learning_block/0/traces
measured.how: python skills/idea/door.py on akiendell, then ls of the traces dir

constraints.text: Rule 1 - every component talks to another only through its public interface; the skill probes and clearance must read traces through learning_block's public functions.
Law 7 - records of truth are permanent: the legacy colon trace file is folded into the new file, never dropped.
learning_block charter: the trace records every firing, consumer-typed at write, debug expiry swept by the next write; no consumer, no trace.
Ticket decisions: writes_to confined to learning_block.py, clearance.py, three skill probes and one proof.
